guard: a destructive manager shutdown is one-shot and bound to the exact live down reservation owner
why: The intent names both the verified manager target and the exact stop process holding the manager pidfile's .stopping reservation.
A target-only intent can survive a CLI crash before SIGTERM and make a later bare stop destructive. The negative controls prove a different reservation and a dead stopper both spare agents.

mutations.name: a different stop attempt is allowed to inherit the destructive intent
mutations.find:
if (reservationOwner !== parsed.stopper.pid)
      return { withAgents: false, warning: "ignored stale manager shutdown intent from a different stop attempt; managed agents were spared" };
mutations.expectRed: a different stop reservation cannot inherit destructive policy
mutations.cell: a different stop reservation cannot inherit destructive policy

mutations.name: a crashed stopper is treated as authorization for destructive shutdown
mutations.find:
if (stopperVerdict.kind !== "match")
      return { withAgents: false, warning: `ignored manager shutdown intent with ${stopperVerdict.kind} stopper identity; managed agents were spared` };
mutations.expectRed: a crashed stopper cannot poison a later bare shutdown
mutations.cell: a crashed stopper cannot poison a later bare shutdown
